On Magmadar you did nothing for the first 19 seconds, with a Serrated Bite on you, and Shazzrah and Gehennas were at about half activity. You had no world buffs and two elixirs. Ragnaros (51, 100% active) and a Dark Mending kick on Sulfuron show what it looks like when you're on the boss.

review.verdict: 88 average, 30 over your usual, on two elixirs and nothing else
review.summary: A big night against your own history: 88 average where you usually sit at 58, top rogue on Shazzrah (95, equal to your best) and Sulfuron, and 94 to 95 on Magmadar and Golemagg. You did it on Giants and Mongoose only: 2 consumable buffs a pull against 3.8 for the other DPS, no food, no Juju, no potions besides a Free Action and a Healing Potion.
